statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116323 (PostgreSQL pltcl reentrant result conversion use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 17.12 for the 17 major version: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116323/ and the 17.12 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/; the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116323, lists 17 as affected before 17.12. Debian fixed it in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-116323. The lowest published build of this owner at PostgreSQL 17.12 is 17.12-0, whose postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on both amd64 and arm64; the later build of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 also reports 17.12. The earlier builds, 17.11-1 and the builds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, are PostgreSQL 17.10 or 17.11 (the published 17.11-1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1 server binaries report PostgreSQL 17.11) and sort below 17.12-0, so they are affected. In the published builds of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and 17.12-0+deb13u1, PL/Tcl ships in the postgresql-pltcl-17 package; the 17.11-1 and 17.12-0 builds publish only a postgresql-17 package, which has no PL/Tcl module, so 17.11-1 is listed as affected although it does not ship PL/Tcl.
